title: PRICE-ONLY ECONOMIC FEATURE DISCOVERY
hypothesis: Economically motivated price momentum, risk and liquidity representations may provide incremental ranking information over the existing three-feature ridge control under nested temporal validation.

data_scope.price: EXP-DATA-005 research price view; PRICE DATA = PASS FOR RESEARCH

baseline.preprocessing: training-only median imputation and z-score scaling

candidate_representation: signal-date eligible cross-sectional percentile rank; raw values retained for quality audit
winsorization: NONE; bounded ranks are used and learned preprocessing remains training-only
missing_policy: missing remains NaN and is imputed from training medians only; never replace missing economic data with zero

candidates.name: sign_consistency_4x20
candidates.formula: mean(1[non-overlapping 20-session return>0]) over last four blocks

candidates.name: log_adv20
candidates.formula: log1p(median(raw_close*volume) over last 20 valid positive-volume observations)

candidates.name: log_adv63
candidates.formula: log1p(median(raw_close*volume) over last 63 valid positive-volume observations)

candidates.name: volume_cv63
candidates.formula: std(volume)/mean(volume) over last 63 valid positive-volume observations

incremental_test.comparison: baseline versus baseline plus one candidate
incremental_test.target_horizon_control: within each outer fold, freeze the baseline's inner-selected target family and horizon for every candidate incremental comparison
incremental_test.outer_role: veto/generalization only; outer cannot add a feature

final_classification.VIABLE: inner-selected in >=3/4 outer procedures AND outer mean delta Rank IC>0 AND median outer delta Rank IC>=0 AND positive outer delta-fold ratio>=0.5 AND mean delta NDCG>=0
final_classification.WEAK_RESEARCH_ONLY: inner-selected in exactly 2/4 procedures OR inner-selected >=3/4 but outer vetoes

phase_gate.PASS: >=3 VIABLE features across >=2 economic families and combined selected procedure outer mean delta Rank IC>0
phase_gate.PARTIAL: >=1 VIABLE feature OR >=2 WEAK_RESEARCH_ONLY features with combined outer mean delta Rank IC>0

family_ablation: only for the per-outer inner-selected combined feature set; remove one economic family at a time; no subset search
